Subject: Post-discovery: request technical deep-dive for Crescent Biotech integration

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the discovery session earlier — that was helpful. Our engineering and security teams would like a focused technical deep-dive to validate networking, auth, and data flow for a potential Redwood deployment. We are aiming for a ~60 minute session the week of Nov 8 so we can circulate an internal recommendation to execs the following week.

High-level asks:
- Walkthrough of deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs VPC/private)
- Network requirements (firewall rules, egress, peering)
- Data retention & logs (where audit logs live, retention controls)
- A brief runbook for a POC (tokens, perf expectations, scale guidance)

Please propose a couple of slots. I will include our SecOps lead (secops@crescentbio.com) and network engineer. I will also attach our current network diagram in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Davis
Head of Integrations, Crescent Biotech
emily@crescentbio.com

Emily / Naomi — thanks for the tag. I’ll run the architecture section and prepare a preliminary topology sketch based on the diagram you share. Quick notes so we can tailor the session:
- Can you confirm whether the POC will target a VPC peering flow, private-hosted (VPC control plane), or on-prem gateway?
- Expected concurrent QPS and typical sequence length for the initial POC (tokens/second) — helps sizing and batch strategy.
- Any encryption-in-transit or HSM/KMS constraints beyond standard cloud KMS?

Draft technical agenda (to be shared at start):
- Topology options + tradeoffs (15m)
- Networking specifics: ports, IPs, egress patterns (15m)
- KV cache and latency profile for short-lived vs long chat sessions (10m)
- Ops/runbook: rollout checklist, smoke tests, rollback triggers (10m)

I’ve attached the agenda Naomi mentioned. If Nov 9 10:00am PT works, I’ll reserve that block and spin up a quick internal checklist to prep the demo environment.

-Ben
